item.title: SBI and Startale Introduce JPYSC, Trust-Backed Yen Stablecoin for Institutional Use
item.description: Startale Group and SBI Holdings have launched JPYSC, a trust bank-backed Japanese yen stablecoin for institutional and cross-border use. The initiative advances Japan’s regulated digital currency infrastructure as global stablecoin competition grows. Japan’s clear legal framework allows financial institutions to issue compliant stablecoins with defined roles and oversight.
